name: Mainline only
purpose: Keep both club lines clear and leave the full space behind them for your display.

name: Back-out siding
purpose: Park on 64 straight studs along the front. Reverse to return to the inner mainline.

name: Double crossover
purpose: Transfer between the two club lines within the mainline corridor.

name: Joel's 10-to-0 mainline
purpose: Shift both mainlines 10 inches through centered S-bends on a Rockford-inspired display.

name: Drive-through siding
purpose: Park on 80 straight studs between the two ends of the inner mainline.

name: R40 right pass-through
purpose: Cross from the outer mainline to the rear track while the middle line stays independent.

name: Dual perpendicular freight spurs
purpose: From the west, either mainline serves both right-side spurs. Each has 32 straight studs.

name: R40 T-junction
purpose: Reach a right-side spur from either end of the inner mainline.

name: R40–R56 T-junction
purpose: Use two perpendicular spurs on a private double-track line.

name: Mirrored S-bend crossings
purpose: Two pairs of tracks swap sides through four 45-degree crossings. The track footprint is about 20 inches deep.

name: Compact mainline
purpose: Keep the two club mainlines clear on a square display.

name: Short back-out siding
purpose: Park on 32 straight studs behind the mainlines. Reverse to return to the inner line.

name: Compact crossover
purpose: Transfer between the two club mainlines in a square display.

name: Compact drive-through
purpose: Leave and rejoin the inner mainline at opposite ends of the siding.

name: Compact freight spur
purpose: Reach a right-side spur from either west mainline. The spur has 32 straight studs.

name: R104 3/4-circle return
purpose: Return trains from one mainline to the other using only R104 curves.

name: R104 semicircle return
purpose: Turn back using an R104 semicircle and a long diagonal.

name: R120 corner return
purpose: Return through an R120 quarter-turn around a 30 by 30 inch corner cutout.

name: Four-track right yard
purpose: Arrive from the west on either mainline. All three storage tracks end flush at the right edge.

name: Eight-track switch yard
purpose: Reach any row via alternating single crossovers. A diagonal links rows 8 and 1.

name: Member R24 staging yard
purpose: Stage cars on six sidings at the west edge for hand-push operation.

name: Member R40 left yard
purpose: Reach six west-edge storage tracks using standard LEGO R40 switches and curves.

name: Member R104 right yard
purpose: Reach six east-edge storage tracks from the inner mainline through an R104 ladder.
